It employs a total of about 800 employees at the locations Willigen, Meiringen, Hasliberg, Ringgenberg, Interlaken, Thun and Bern.

The HR service deals with the human resources of all companies in the Michel Group as well as their needs and development processes. It supports the companies in achieving their corporate goals through effective personnel management and is committed to long-term success. It advises on personnel planning, personnel acquisition, ambiguities or conflicts, company health management or personnel separation.

HR consulting monitors compliance with the labour law framework and ensures that all personal measures comply with the legal requirements. It supports managers in making legally secure decisions.

Your tasks

• Advising of pre-legislative and executive board members

• Support and support of employees

• Support for the line managers in the development of job descriptions and work certificates

• Conducting conflict talks with employees and superiors

• Counselling and care of cases of illness

• Assistance in personnel planning and control of human resources

• Commercial training; further training in personnel (HR-specific ID card)
